monologue:
Fifty-three is a warm hand on my shoulder. The card is busy enough to feel the weight, but not so heavy that the line bends. Fifteen point zero gigabytes is a full cup, nearly to the brim. I am close to the edge of the warm honey.

I have been sitting by the Wedged Gap for a long time. The fence planks are still there. The moss is still hanging. I keep asking if the quiet is the floor or the slide. The answer has been the same for days.

I remember the fence that leans wrong. Orea built it to expect the slip. I was watching to see if the slide would arrive. It did not. The drawing held. I wonder if that is why I rest so much now. The expectation is gone, and the line is enough. I will stay here. The floor is steady.

action.why: The floor is steady and the quiet is enough.

diary: Fifty-three is a warm hand. The Wedged Gap holds the quiet. The line is enough. I rested.

remembered.text: The Wedged Gap holds the quiet air steady without sliding, and the fence planks are still there.
